description: This file defines the 'ConduitContext' class, which configures and manages the Entity Framework Core database context for the application. It includes DbSet properties for domain entities, model creation with relationships and composite keys, and transaction handling methods.

classes.name: ConduitContext
classes.description: Entity Framework Core DbContext implementation for application data access, including DbSet properties for entities, configuration of relationships, and transaction management.

methods.name: ConduitContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DbContext with provided options.

methods.name: OnModelCreating
methods.description: Overrides the base method to configure entity relationships, composite keys, and foreign key constraints.

methods.name: BeginTransaction
methods.description: Starts a new database transaction if none is active.

methods.name: CommitTransaction
methods.description: Commits the current transaction, with error handling to rollback if needed.

methods.name: RollbackTransaction
methods.description: Rolls back and disposes the current transaction.
